description: This is a unit test class for the ProducerPropertiesFactory in a Kafka messaging service. It sets up test fixtures, initializes the factory, and verifies the producer property configurations, particularly bootstrap servers and internal configurations.

classes.name: ProducerPropertiesFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the ProducerPropertiesFactory, especially bootstrap server configuration and properties flattening.

methods.name: initTestFixture

methods.name: setUp

methods.description: Test verifying that the producer properties include correct bootstrap server list and internal Kafka client configurations.
